jobs.title: Junior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Build and maintain backend services and REST APIs. Write clean Python services, design relational schemas, containerize applications with Docker, and contribute automated tests in a continuous delivery pipeline. Collaborate with product and frontend teams on API contracts. Experience with FastAPI/Django or equivalent frameworks preferred. You will participate in code reviews, on-call basics, and incremental delivery of customer-facing features.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description: Contribute to API-driven platform services. Implement secure REST endpoints, write SQL against PostgreSQL/MySQL, debug distributed systems on Linux, and use Git-based pull request workflows. Familiarity with containers, messaging, and automated testing is valued. Mentorship provided for graduates transitioning into production engineering.

jobs.title: Backend Developer Intern
jobs.company: Sysco LABS Sri Lanka (public JD pattern)
jobs.description: Support engineering teams building internal and customer-facing APIs. Learn production backend practices including code quality, unit testing, SQL data access, and Docker-based local development. Strong problem-solving and communication skills required. Ideal for final-year students seeking internship experience in enterprise software delivery.

jobs.title: Graduate Backend Developer
jobs.description: Join product squads delivering cloud-hosted backend features. Responsibilities include implementing service endpoints, writing tests, optimizing SQL queries, and deploying containerized services to AWS. You will work in agile sprints with code reviews and continuous integration. Prior internship or strong academic projects in backend systems preferred.

jobs.title: Junior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: Build accessible, high-quality user interfaces with React and TypeScript. Translate designs into responsive components, manage client state thoughtfully, write component tests, and collaborate with designers and backend engineers on API integration. Strong CSS fundamentals and attention to UX detail are essential.

jobs.title: UI Engineer - Product
jobs.description: Implement product UI features using modern React patterns. Own component libraries, ensure accessibility, integrate REST APIs, and maintain high frontend test coverage. Experience with design systems and TypeScript strongly preferred for graduate and junior hires.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer Intern
jobs.description: Assist frontend teams shipping enterprise product screens. Learn React component structure, responsive layout, Git collaboration, and code review practices. Academic projects demonstrating UI craftsmanship and JavaScript fundamentals are expected.

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description: Analyze operational and customer datasets to produce actionable insights. Write SQL queries, clean data with Python/Excel, build Power BI dashboards, and present findings to stakeholders. Statistical literacy and clear storytelling are core requirements for early-career analysts.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Graduate
jobs.description: Support BI initiatives by modeling metrics, building dashboards, validating data quality, and partnering with business teams. Strong SQL and visualization skills required. Python for automation and exploratory analysis is a plus.

jobs.title: Data Analyst Intern
jobs.description: Work with product and operations data to uncover trends. Responsibilities include writing SQL, preparing Excel analyses, assisting dashboard development, and documenting metric definitions. Curiosity and clear communication matter as much as technical skill.

knowledge_docs.content: Backend hiring managers typically screen for API design ability, SQL fluency, testing discipline, and deployment basics (Docker/CI). Resumes that quantify latency, reliability, or throughput outcomes convert better than generic 'built APIs' bullets.
Docker and automated testing appear repeatedly in junior backend job descriptions across product companies. A single containerized project with pytest coverage is high-leverage evidence.

Learning path: (1) FastAPI CRUD with PostgreSQL, (2) add JWT auth and OpenAPI docs, (3) write pytest suite, (4) Dockerfile + compose with Postgres, (5) GitHub Actions CI that runs tests on pull requests.
Recommended practice project: Career readiness API with resume upload, async analysis job status, and report persistence — mirrors real backend workflows (auth optional for MVP).

Common backend interview themes: REST vs RPC, SQL joins and indexing, ACID basics, Docker layers, testing pyramid, debugging a failing endpoint, and explaining a past project architecture with trade-offs.
Behavioral prompts: describe a production bug you fixed, how you prioritize tech debt vs features, and how you collaborate with frontend on API contracts.
Frontend roles prioritize React (or equivalent), JavaScript fundamentals, TypeScript readiness, accessible components, and measurable UX outcomes in portfolio projects.
Hiring managers look for TypeScript usage, responsive CSS craftsmanship, and evidence of working against real API contracts rather than static mock screens alone.

Learning path: (1) React + TypeScript component library, (2) routing and data fetching with loading/error states, (3) form validation and accessibility checks, (4) Vitest/React Testing Library, (5) deploy a polished portfolio app.

Common frontend interview themes: reconciliation/virtual DOM intuition, controlled vs uncontrolled inputs, state management trade-offs, CSS layout (flex/grid), performance (memoization sparingly), and accessibility basics.
Data analyst readiness centers on SQL depth, clean metric definitions, dashboard storytelling, and the ability to recommend decisions — not just charts.
Standout projects combine SQL + visualization + a clear business recommendation with assumptions documented.

Learning path: (1) advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs), (2) Excel/Power Query hygiene, (3) Python pandas cleaning notebook, (4) Power BI dashboard with DAX basics, (5) write a one-page insight memo for stakeholders.
Common analyst interview themes: SQL case questions, defining North Star metrics, handling missing data, choosing chart types, and explaining a past analysis that changed a decision.

Career readiness improves fastest when skill gaps are prioritized by hiring impact from real job descriptions, then closed with portfolio evidence and targeted interview practice within a weekly plan.
A practical 7-day cadence: refine resume keywords, study one high-impact gap, ship a mini artifact, update resume evidence, practice interviews, apply to high-alignment roles, review weekly progress.
